2026_01_DAL_NYG.headline: Dallas’ protection depth faces New York’s pressure-first identity
2026_01_DAL_NYG.paragraph1: Dallas reaches the opener with questions along the interior offensive line, while New York is built to make that weakness matter with a pressure-oriented front. The Giants also carry uncertainty around Malik Nabers, so their offense may need Jaxson Dart to create efficiently without relying on one matchup winner. Dallas still has Dak Prescott, CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens to punish single coverage. The game turns on whether New York can speed Prescott up before Dallas’ receivers separate and whether the Giants can generate enough explosive offense in response.
2026_01_DAL_NYG.model_rationale: Dallas has the stronger passing-game ceiling, but New York can tilt the matchup if its front consistently disrupts protection and forces Prescott into hurried, low-efficiency possessions.
